ticket.title: docs check -d takes a directory and a member name interchangeably, so the same flag meant two things
ticket.description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-07: `chalkline docs check -d common`, run with the working directory set to `common` (which is how storypole verify runs a chain), resolved the name under the current directory and failed with "Failed to inspect workspace: invalid workspace layout: Missing Cargo.toml at common". The eleven member chains were all written that way and none had ever been executed, because the default-chain fallback bug (a626638) meant member tickets always ran the harness chain instead. Chains now pass -d . ; the flag itself still accepts a directory and a member name interchangeably, so the same mistake is available again.

LIVE 2026-11-07, from inside common/ with the rebuilt binary:

  chalkline docs check -d common   -> 9 present, 0 missing, 0 drifted   (was: Missing Cargo.toml at common)
  chalkline docs check -d .        -> 9 present, 0 missing, 0 drifted   (the path reading still works)
  chalkline docs check -d nope     -> "--dir 'nope' is neither a directory (.../common/nope does not exist) nor a member of the suite containing .../common"

Committed as dad5bee, verified with the chalkline chain.
